state.question: Which videos prepare the batter without using eggs?
state.summary: v2 is the strongest egg-use case because of visible eggshells near the pale yellow batter, making options A and B less supported. v3 has the clearest visible non-egg batter preparation evidence: beer poured into flour and later fish dipped into the prepared batter, with no eggs in the cited local spans. v4 shows a liquid mixture with orange swirls and a separate dry mixture, but no visible egg cracking or addition in the cited span; the orange swirl remains ambiguous between egg and another ingredient. v1 also lacks visible eggs, but its liquid source is unresolved. Given the available choices, C is the best-supported option, though whole-video absence of eggs is not definitively proven.
inference_protocol: Video IDs identify the normalized input clips/views and must never be inferred from event or slot IDs.
A reasoning cycle is PLAN -> local FOCUS observation -> memory revision -> fresh state projection; completing one cycle does not imply sufficient evidence.
FOCUS evidence is valid only for its cited video and time span; it cannot prove whole-video or cross-video absence.
Count physical entities or transitions, not frames, mentions, or duplicate observations of the same event.
The final answer must be exactly one option label from the supplied choices, never a video ID, option text, refusal, or unknown.
If evidence remains incomplete when no executable visual budget remains, choose the best-supported option label and retain the uncertainty in the summary.

attempts: v1 shows dry ingredients being combined with a white liquid and then a thick batter, but the liquid source and any earlier egg addition remain unresolved.
v2 shows brown eggshells adjacent to a whisked pale yellow batter, which supports that eggs were used in that batter preparation, even though the cracking moment is not visible.

v3 shows beer and flour handling followed by dipping fish into batter with no eggs in the cited spans, while v4 shows an orange-swirled liquid mixture whose origin is unresolved; neither proves whole-video absence of eggs.
